html:
flowchart LR
    classDef event fill:#3d6b5e,stroke:#24443b,color:#ffffff
    classDef trigger fill:#1f3a33,stroke:#1f3a33,color:#ffffff
    classDef task fill:#eceeef,stroke:#5b6168,color:#1f2328
    classDef done fill:#e3efe6,stroke:#3d6b5e,color:#1f2328

    subgraph W3 [W3 · Booking and Reminder]
        A[Direct calendar link<br/>consult calendar] --> B([⚡ Appointment Status<br/>Confirmed])
        B --> C[Tag behavior-booked-consult<br/>Remove 3 status tags]
        C --> D[Conversion Event<br/>Move to pipeline:<br/>Consult Booked]
        D --> E[👤 Prep task for John]
        E --> F[Email 6 – Confirmation]
        F --> G{SMS consent?<br/>24h before}
        G -->|No| H[Email 7 – 24h Reminder]
        G -->|Yes| I[24-Hour Reminder SMS]
        H --> J[1-Hour Reminder Email]
        I --> J
    end

    subgraph W4 [W4 · Outcome and Recovery]
        J --> K{Showed?}
        K -->|Yes| L[Conversion Event<br/>Consult Completed]
        L --> M([✔ Consult Completed])
        K -->|No| N{Newer booking<br/>live?}
        N -->|Yes| O([✔ Newer booking<br/>owns contact])
        N -->|No| P[Remove behavior-booked-consult<br/>Tag status-no-show]
    end

    class B trigger
    class D,L event
    class E task
    class M,O done
